name: familial isolated hypoparathyroidism due to agenesis of parathyroid gland
description: Hypoparathyroidism in which the inheritance is recessive and linked to the q26-q27 region of the X chromosome. The parathyroid glands are usually incompletely developed (parathyroid dysgenesis) or absent (parathyroid agenesis).
